title: Fenchone alleviates 7-ketocholesterol-induced oxiapoptophagy through activation of KLF4-PPARgamma-Arg1-mediated M2 macrophage signalling.
authors: Ravi, Sangeetha; Martin, Livya Catherene; Kumaresan, Manikandan; Mani, Jaya Suriya; Manikandan, Beulaja; Ramar, Manikandan
journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子fenchone通过KLF4-PPARgamma-Arg1轴缓解巨噬细胞氧化凋亡，虽涉及转录因子KLF4/PPARgamma与分子对接，但核心是细胞表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: 7-ketocholesterol (7KCh), a cytotoxic oxysterol enriched in atherosclerotic plaques, provokes macrophage dysfunction through oxiapoptophagy, a linked process of oxidative stress, apoptosis and autophagy culminating in pro-inflammatory M1 polarization. Targeting this process could mitigate oxysterol-driven vascular inflammation. In this study, murine IC-21 macrophages were induced with 7KCh and co-exposed to fenchone, a bicyclic monoterpene with known anti-inflammatory properties. Cellular oxidative stress, apoptosis and autophagy were assessed by spectrofluorometric and cytometric assays. Expression of key mediators (iNOS, COX2, HO1, Casp3, Bcl2, LC3B, PARP1, Arg1, KLF4 and PPARgamma) was quantified by RT-qPCR and western blotting. Molecular docking was used to identify interactions of fenchone with KLF4 and PPARgamma. The results showed that 7KCh significantly increased ROS and NO production, disrupted mitochondrial membrane potential and induced apoptosis and autophagy in macrophages. Fenchone co-treatment counteracted these effects, restoring redox balance and membrane integrity. Molecular analyses revealed downregulation of iNOS, COX2, Casp3 and PARP1, alongside upregulation of HO1, Arg1, KLF4 and PPARgamma. Docking analysis confirmed strong binding of fenchone to KLF4 and PPARgamma, suggesting transcriptional regulation of macrophage polarization via the KLF4-PPARgamma-Arg1 axis. These findings suggest that fenchone mitigates 7KCh-induced oxiapoptophagy and reprograms macrophages toward an anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype through modulation of KLF4/PPARgamma signalling, positioning fenchone as a potential immunomodulatory candidate for combating oxysterol-mediated vascular inflammation.
abstract_zh: 7-酮胆固醇（7KCh）是一种富集于动脉粥样硬化斑块中的细胞毒性氧甾醇，通过氧凋亡（oxiapoptophagy）——即氧化应激、凋亡和自噬的关联过程，最终导致促炎性M1极化——引发巨噬细胞功能障碍。靶向这一过程可能减轻氧甾醇驱动的血管炎症。在本研究中，小鼠IC-21巨噬细胞经7KCh诱导，并同时暴露于芬酮（fenchone），一种具有已知抗炎特性的双环单萜。通过分光荧光法和细胞计数法评估细胞氧化应激、凋亡和自噬。关键介质（iNOS、COX2、HO1、Casp3、Bcl2、LC3B、PARP1、Arg1、KLF4和PPARgamma）的表达通过RT-qPCR和western blotting定量。分子对接用于识别芬酮与KLF4和PPARgamma的相互作用。结果表明，7KCh显著增加ROS和NO产生，破坏线粒体膜电位，并诱导巨噬细胞凋亡和自噬。芬酮联合处理拮抗了这些效应，恢复氧化还原平衡和膜完整性。分子分析显示iNOS、COX2、Casp3和PARP1下调，同时HO1、Arg1、KLF4和PPARgamma上调。对接分析确认芬酮与KLF4和PPARgamma强结合，提示通过KLF4-PPARgamma-Arg1轴对巨噬细胞极化进行转录调控。这些发现表明，芬酮通过调节KLF4/PPARgamma信号，减轻7KCh诱导的氧凋亡并将巨噬细胞重编程为抗炎性M2表型，从而将芬酮定位为对抗氧甾醇介导血管炎症的潜在免疫调节候选物。
